Name: Hasta La Vuelta Señor
Address: Chile Oe6-40 y Cuenca, Quito, Ecuador
Description: A classic spot in the historic center that feels like a window into traditional Quito. It’s the kind of place where you can truly experience Ecuadorian flavors in an authentic setting.

Name: Casa Gangotena Restaurant
Address: Calle Bolívar OE6-41 y Cuenca, Quito 170401, Ecuador
Description: A refined take on Ecuadorian cuisine located in Plaza San Francisco. I associate this place with special occasions and showing visitors a more elegant side of Quito.

Name: Zazu
Address: Av. Diego de Almagro E8-48, Quito 170518, Ecuador
Description: One of Quito’s most recognized modern restaurants, blending local ingredients with international techniques. It represents how Ecuadorian cuisine has evolved.

Name: Somos Ecuador Restaurante
Description: A restaurant focused on celebrating Ecuadorian identity through food. I would take someone here to understand Ecuadorian culture beyond tourism.

Name: El Ventanal
Address: Av. Isabel la Católica N24-274, Quito 170143, Ecuador
Description: A traditional restaurant I connect with family meals and comfort food. The flavors feel familiar and represent everyday Ecuadorian cuisine.

Name: Café Mosaico
Address: Manuel Samaniego N24-163 y Lizardo García, Quito 170143, Ecuador
Description: A modern café known for its city views. I associate this place with spending time with friends and enjoying Quito from above.

Name: Chez Jérôme
Address: Mall Paseo San Francisco, Cumbayá, Quito, Ecuador
Description: A contemporary restaurant that blends international flavors with a local atmosphere. It reflects the modern side of Quito’s food scene.

Name: La Ronda Restaurante
Description: Located on one of Quito’s most iconic streets, this restaurant connects food with history and tradition.

Name: Urko Cocina Local
Address: Av. Coruña N25-03 y Colón, Quito 170135, Ecuador
Description: A restaurant focused on local ingredients and sustainability, showing a modern and thoughtful approach to Ecuadorian cuisine.

Name: Fankør
Address: Avenida Amazonas N34-451 y República, Quito, Ecuador
Description: A modern and experimental restaurant that highlights creativity and global influences within Quito’s dining scene.

Name: Pavarotti Restaurant
Address: Av. 12 de Octubre N24-244 y República, Quito 170143, Ecuador
Description: A well-known restaurant in Quito offering Italian cuisine with a warm, classic atmosphere. It’s a place I associate with long dinners and celebrating special moments.

Name: Marenostrum
Description: A modern restaurant focused on seafood and Mediterranean flavors. I like coming here when I want something different and a more upscale dining experience.
